name: Gemini CLI
notes: Headless: prompt via stdin (non-TTY), `--output-format stream-json`; write tasks `--approval-mode auto_edit`, read-only `--approval-mode plan` (google-gemini/gemini-cli docs/cli/cli-reference.md). `--yolo` / `--approval-mode yolo` are never used.

Google sign-in no longer works for personal accounts: since 2026 Gemini CLI answers `IneligibleTierError: This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals` and points to Antigravity (checked 2026-11-17, gemini-cli 0.68.0). Use the Antigravity agent (agy) instead, or an API key (paid). HidForge only checks that a key variable is set; it never reads it.
Headless runs also need Gemini CLI folder trust, which HidForge does not grant.

auth.hint: вхід через Google у Gemini CLI для особистих акаунтів більше не працює (Google перевів його в Antigravity) — використовуйте агента Antigravity або впишіть GEMINI_API_KEY у .env (платно)
